channel.title: Tuned blog
channel.description: News, guides and what's new in Tuned.

item.title: What's new in Tuned 1.13.0
item.description: Tuned 1.13 adds Tuned accounts, so every device keeps the same playlists and settings, plus new home screen widgets and casting that ends when you close the player.

item.title: What's new in Tuned 1.12.0
item.description: Tuned 1.12 adds signing in on a TV with your phone, the new channel stack icon, a cleaner player with fit and lock buttons, and remote-friendly screens on TVs and tablets.

item.title: How to add a MAC portal (Stalker) playlist to Tuned
item.description: Sign in the way a MAG set-top box does, with the portal address and the MAC address your provider registered.

item.title: How to add an M3U playlist link or file to Tuned
item.description: Add any M3U or M3U8 link, with or without a guide link, or open an .m3u file saved on your device.

item.title: How to add an Xtream Codes playlist to Tuned
item.description: Sign in with the server address, username and password your provider sent, and get Live TV, Movies, Shows and the guide in one step.

item.title: How to cast from Tuned to a Chromecast or smart TV
item.description: Send live TV, films and episodes to a Chromecast, a TV with Chromecast built in, or a DLNA TV, including what you downloaded.

item.title: How to change the user agent in Tuned
item.description: When a server refuses to play or load your playlist, sending another player's user agent often fixes it. Here's how.

item.title: How to fix buffering in Tuned
item.description: Why IPTV streams stall, and the settings and checks that fix most buffering, from buffering modes to backup copies.

item.title: How to record live TV and download films and episodes in Tuned
item.description: Save films, episodes and whole seasons to watch offline, and record the live channel you're watching, all on one connection.

item.title: How to set up profiles, kids profiles and PINs in Tuned
item.description: Give everyone their own favourites and Continue Watching, make a kids profile, and lock profiles and adult categories with a PIN.

item.title: How to set up the TV guide (EPG) in Tuned
item.description: Get what's on now and next on every channel, the full grid guide, reminders, and fixes for channels with the wrong times.

item.title: How to sign in to Tuned on a TV with your phone
item.description: Skip typing a server and password with a remote. Scan a QR code on the TV and fill it in on your phone instead.

item.title: How to use subtitles and captions in Tuned
item.description: Turn captions on, style them, fix their timing, and find subtitles for films and episodes that don't have any.

item.title: How to watch catch-up TV in Tuned
item.description: Replay programmes from the past few days on channels your provider records, from the guide or the grid.

item.title: IPTV glossary: EPG, M3U, Xtream Codes, catch-up and more
item.description: Plain-English meanings of the IPTV terms you'll meet when setting up a player, from EPG and M3U to MAC portals and catch-up.

item.title: Provider errors in Tuned and what they mean
item.description: Sign-in refused, channels won't load, a stream won't play: what each message means and how to fix it.
